answerCheck.reason: The section meets six edges at their midpoints and is a regular hexagon with side 1/2. Its area is 6·(√3/4)·(1/2)²=3√3/8. Thus a=3, b=3, c=8, and a+b+c=14.
The pyramid height is h = √(1 - 1/2) = 1/√2. If the cube side is s, its top section has side 1 - s/h, so s = 1 - √2s and s = √2 - 1. Therefore its volume is (√2 - 1)³ = 5√2 - 7.
